scoring_justification: The headline quantities are computed from a full DFT+DFPT+BTE pipeline; recomputing from raw artifacts is infeasible (the raw data would be huge and require domain-specific solvers), so we compare the agent's reported values to the paper's published results using a threshold-or-better tolerance policy.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference conductivity and mobility values from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Fig. 1: InSe-e conductivity 20 e^2/h, mobility 490 cm^2/Vs; P4-h conductivity 36 e^2/h, mobility 640 cm^2/Vs
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published values for the same materials at the same conditions; they match the reference oracle solve.sh and the paper's reported data.

outputs.description: Computed phonon-limited electrical conductivity (in e^2/h) and carrier mobility (in cm^2/Vs) for electron-doped InSe (InSe-e) and hole-doped phosphorene (P4-h) at T=300 K and sheet carrier density 10^13 cm^{-2}.

output_contract.notes: The scored checker compares these values against the paper's reported results using a threshold_or_better tolerance policy. No other outputs are scored.

steps.description: Validate the computed conductivity and mobility for InSe-e and P4-h against paper reference values
